description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the variable N and the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage, comparing the performance of different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled 'N', has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'AUC (%)', also has a linear scale, spans from 75 to 100, and is marked at intervals of 5. There are five lines in the plot, each representing a different model or configuration: a blue line with circle markers, an orange line with square markers, a green line with star markers, a red line with diamond markers, and a purple line with triangle markers, all with solid line styles. The blue line starts at approximately 95% AUC at N=1, peaks at 100% AUC at N=5 and N=10, and then declines to around 94% AUC at N=20. The orange line begins at about 88% AUC at N=1, rises to a peak of 99% AUC at N=10, and then decreases to around 90% AUC at N=20. The green line starts at roughly 85% AUC at N=1, increases to around 92% AUC at N=10, and continues to rise to approximately 93% AUC at N=20. The red line begins at about 87% AUC at N=1, increases to around 93% AUC at N=5, peaks at 94% AUC at N=10, and then slightly decreases to approximately 94% AUC at N=20. The purple line starts at around 80% AUC at N=1, remains relatively stable until N=5, then sharply increases to a peak of around 96% AUC at N=10, before declining to approximately 82% AUC at N=20.
